newsitem.title: USA: Nuveen, Charles Schwab complete Honolulu bond deal.
newsitem.headline: Nuveen, Charles Schwab complete Honolulu bond deal.

text.p: John Nuveen Co said it completed a $100 million municipal bond deal for the city of Honolulu that targeted individual investors.
Nuveen said it partnered with Charles Schwab Corp, the San Francisco-based brokerage firm, in the placement of some of the bonds to individual investors.
Since the offering period began, with pricing on September 19, more than $7.9 million was purchased by individual investors. More than 53 percent was placed with customers of Charles Schwab.
"These investors are attractive to Honolulu because they are traditionally long-term bondholders," said Clifton Fenton, vice president and manager of investment banking at Nuveen.
The Honolulu issue was structured so that individual investors were given a five day advance period before it was opened to institutions.
